svg.title: ORACLE
svg.desc: Oracle: a tall standing stone in a dusk meadow, its face carved with rows of glowing entries like a ledger, a figure adding a new page while a circle of eight holds lanterns, five lit and raised, three dark. A collaborative, versioned research decision record for a group: nothing is written until enough of the group approves.

g.text: A collaborative, versioned research decision record for a
group: decisions, notes, living documents and a library,
every change passing through review before it is written.
